title: Meow agent onboarding
description: A white two-column feature: a 32px title, a paragraph, an orange button that turns ink on hover beside an outlined one, and a wrap of small boxed chips each led by a green dot (the last one dashed); a 16:9 video slot sits vertically centred on the right. On phones the video comes first and the buttons go full width.
notes: media: the 16:9 video is a placeholder box until filled
the last chip can be a dashed 'and more' link
name: meow-agent

props.name: primary
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }
props.description: the filled button (orange, turns ink on hover)

props.name: chips
props.description: the boxed capability chips, each with a green dot

props.name: more
props.description: a last, dashed chip linking to the full list, e.g. "and more"

props.name: media
props.description: the video (or image) on the right; a 16:9 placeholder when empty
